weaknesses.title: SUM/AVG/SORTN ignore composite name:ms fields
weaknesses.detail: SYS SUM on 'api:120\ndb:50' returns LAST_N=0 COUNT=0 — non-numeric whole fields skipped. Agents must EACH+AFTER+PUSH peel scores first. No field-after-sep aggregate form.

weaknesses.title: SORTN cannot order name:ms by latency
weaknesses.detail: SORTN DESC on composite plate does not yield hottest-first plate. pinhot must O(n) max walk + MOVELINE. No key-field numeric sort.
weaknesses.repro: SORTN DESC 'mesh:200\napi:95' not ordered by ms

weaknesses.title: COUNTLINE exact — cannot COUNTLINE ':200' or breach by pattern
weaknesses.detail: COUNTLINE bag ':200' → 0. Breach counts need EACH+CMP. Same exact-field class as prior iters.

weaknesses.title: GREP bare probe name matches cousins
weaknesses.detail: GREP 'api' keeps api:95 and api_v2:50. Identity needs BEFORE+EQS.

weaknesses.title: No string concat — observe tokens via REPLACEALL NAME:VAL
weaknesses.detail: Latency token rebuild same REPLACEALL footgun as budget/flag boards.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON collapses multi-line bags and score peels
weaknesses.detail: bag and scores both collapse (955020050). Aggregates must be scalars.

weaknesses.title: WRITE often omits final trailing newline
weaknesses.detail: cat -A last field without $ after seed/observe.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON idents are case-sensitive var names
weaknesses.detail: PRINT_JSON ... thresh ... with var THRESH emitted thresh:0 (missing). Must match exact case THRESH.
weaknesses.repro: DEFAULT THRESH=100; PRINT_JSON thresh → 0 or absent

weaknesses.title: Plate reorder by metric needs peel+sort+rejoin — no keyed MOVELINE
weaknesses.detail: Cannot SORTN plate in place by after-colon key then rewrite rows. Agents either pinhot single max or rebuild whole plate.
weaknesses.repro: no form: SORTBY bag sep field_n

workarounds: Aggregates: EACH AFTER ':' PUSH pure scores then SUM/AVG/SORTN/MIN/MAX
pinhot: walk CMP max + FINDLINE + MOVELINE (not SORTN composite)
Identity: BEFORE ':' + EQS — not GREP name
PRINT_JSON only scalar sum/avg/min/max; keep bag on plate file
PRINT_JSON idents must match var case exactly (THRESH not thresh)
Always LET bag = LAST after PUSH/SETMATCH/MOVELINE
language_gaps: SUM/AVG/SORTN by field after separator (keyed aggregates)
In-place bag sort by numeric key field
issues_faced: SUM on composite latency bag silently 0 — easy agent footgun without peel
PRINT_JSON thresh vs THRESH case mismatch reported thresh:0 until fixed
scores bag also PRINT_JSON-collapses so sortpeek must expose hit scalar
